site.about.heroBody: Momentizing Holistic Center offers mental health consulting and counseling for people living between cultures. We work with individuals, couples, families, institutions and organizations whose different backgrounds shape how they relate, work and heal.
site.about.heroTitle: Celebrating our differences, savoring the present.
site.about.journeyBody: From Taiwan to Indonesia and across the globe: different places, shared human stories.
site.about.mission1: Provide information and consultation about global relationships.
site.about.mission2: Enhance collaborative performance to share cross-cultural experiences.
site.about.mission3: Enable people to navigate life in a way that fits their cultural identity and values.
site.about.stop1.art: Illustration of a tall tiered tower in front of hills at sunset
site.about.stop1.body: Our founder began this journey as an expat in Taiwan, living inside a new culture, a new language and a new way of life. That experience sparked a deep interest in multicultural understanding and in the mental health needs of people moving between cultures.
site.about.stop1.title: The beginning
site.about.stop2.art: Illustration of a video call with six friendly faces and a speech bubble
site.about.stop2.body1: During the COVID-19 pandemic we launched the Fall Internship Program (FIP), connecting with interns and associates across Taiwan and Indonesia.
site.about.stop2.body2: We also opened spaces such as the Momentizing Discussion Forum and Support Group, where friends from diaspora, expatriate, international student and cross-cultural communities share their stories and the experience of cultural adjustment and life transitions.
site.about.stop2.title: Building through uncertain times
site.about.stop3.art: Illustration of a tall monument and a city skyline
site.about.stop3.body: Our founder returned to Indonesia to study professional psychology, specialising in adult clinical psychology in Jakarta. The aim was to deepen clinical expertise and keep supporting Indonesians with a broader, more integrated approach.
site.about.stop3.title: Back to Indonesia
site.about.stop4.art: Illustration of a calm room with an armchair, a plant and a cup of tea
site.about.stop4.body: Today we keep building Momentizing Holistic Center with a dedicated team, offering holistic mental health support for individuals, couples and families. We aim to make safe, supportive and culturally inclusive spaces for healing, growth and a better life.
site.about.support1: Students and professionals across borders, living in different cities, islands or countries.
site.about.support2: People in mixed marriages with contrasting backgrounds, such as age, education, occupation, ethnicity, religion, race or nationality.
site.about.support3: Anyone exposed to diverse cultures or systems who is facing challenges of adjustment and relationships.
site.about.supportBody: Life across cultures can be rich and tiring at the same time. We keep company with people who are adjusting, belonging and building relationships in more than one world.
site.about.vision: Empower global citizens to create memorable moments while encountering intercultural relationships.

site.home.alreadyBody: Log in to your Momentizing account to message your specialist, track your mood, and use your ADHD tools.
site.home.approachA: We don't believe in "one size fits all." Every journey begins with a
site.home.approachB: to map your history, triggers, and goals.
site.home.assessmentBody: In-depth clinical evaluation for ADHD, anxiety, depression, and cross-cultural adjustment issues.
site.home.corporateB: training, EAP frameworks, and proactive burnout prevention workshops. We help distributed teams maintain high empathy and performance across time zones.
site.home.faq.cancel.a: You can cancel or reschedule directly from your bookings page. We ask for as much notice as possible so your specialist's time can be offered to someone else — check your confirmation for the specific notice window.
site.home.faq.cancel.q: What if I need to cancel or reschedule a session?
site.home.faq.choosePackage.a: Most clients begin with a single session for an intake assessment. If you're planning on long-term support, the 5 or 10 session packages offer significant cost reductions and priority scheduling.
site.home.faq.choosePackage.q: How do I choose the right package?
site.home.faq.confidential.a: Yes. Sessions, journal entries, and messages are private between you and your specialist. We never share your personal health information with third parties without your consent, except where required by law.
site.home.faq.crisis.a: No — Momentizing is not equipped for emergencies or immediate crisis intervention. If you're in danger or need urgent support, please contact local emergency services or visit our Crisis Resources page, available anytime without an account.
site.home.faq.crisis.q: Is Momentizing a crisis or emergency service?
site.home.faq.global.a: Yes. We specialize in the diaspora. All sessions are conducted via secure, HIPAA-compliant video conferencing accessible from anywhere in the world.
site.home.faq.insurance.a: We don't bill insurance directly today, but every completed session generates a receipt you can submit to your insurer or employer for reimbursement, available from your account.
site.home.faq.insurance.q: Do you accept insurance, or provide receipts?
site.home.faq.quick.a: Straight away. Choose a real open time on the website, then confirm it with one WhatsApp message — no account and no waiting. If you can't find a time that suits you, tell us and our team will contact you on WhatsApp, typically within one business day.
site.home.faq.quick.q: How quickly will I be confirmed?
site.home.faq.support.a: Message us on WhatsApp at {number}, use the "Ask our team" form, or, once you have an account, use in-app messaging — our support team monitors all three.
site.home.faq.support.q: How do I get in touch with support?
site.home.faq.switch.a: Absolutely — fit matters more than momentum. Message our support team or use "Match me instead" from your account and we'll connect you with someone new, no awkward conversation required.
site.home.faq.switch.q: Can I switch specialists if it's not the right fit?
site.home.faq.teams.a: Yes — we provide Mental Health First Aid training, EAP frameworks, and burnout-prevention workshops for distributed teams. Use "Inquire for Corporate" below or reach out via WhatsApp to start the conversation.
site.home.faq.teams.q: Do you offer support for organizations and teams?
site.home.faq.timezone.a: You pick a time in your own local timezone when booking — the system handles the conversion with your specialist automatically. We have associates across multiple time zones so early-morning and late-evening slots are usually available.
site.home.faq.timezone.q: What timezone are sessions scheduled in?
site.home.faq.unusedSessions.a: Package sessions don't expire on a rigid schedule — you and your specialist set the cadence together. If your circumstances change, reach out via your account or WhatsApp and our team will help you adjust.
site.home.faq.unusedSessions.q: What happens if I don't use all the sessions in my package?
site.home.faq.vetted.a: Every associate submits their licence number and credentials during registration, and our team verifies them before the profile is approved and made visible in the directory. Unapproved or rejected applicants are never shown to clients.
site.home.faq.video.a: Just a stable internet connection and a device with a camera and microphone — laptop, tablet, or phone all work. We'll send a secure video link ahead of your appointment; no extra software to install.
site.home.faq.video.q: What do I need for a video session?
site.home.faq.whatsapp.a: Yes. Tap the WhatsApp icon in the navigation or footer to chat directly with our team on {number}. When you book on the website you'll also confirm your booking on WhatsApp, so both routes end up in the same place.
site.home.faq.whatsapp.q: Can I book a session via WhatsApp instead of the website?
